svg.title: Revised concentric-ring layout options for the 14-sensor BRIAN 2.0 array
svg.desc: Three top-down layout options: a single ring with contiguous rail arcs, a single ring with interleaved rail assignment, and two concentric rings split by voltage rail, each with BME680 at center and an optional dashed chamber boundary.

text.style: fill:rgb(11, 11, 11);stroke:none;color:rgb(11, 11, 11);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"Anthropic Serif Variable", "Anthropic Serif", ui-serif, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:auto

g.text: Rail traces stay short and contiguous.

g.text: Rail traces cross the ring more — harder routing.
